added: Add the sync capability gate: `SyncCapabilityPolicy`, `closedSyncCapabilities`, the `sync_capabilities:<deviceId>` record (`syncCapabilityKeyPrefix`, `syncCapabilityRecordValue`, `decodeSyncCapabilityRecord`), and `SyncReportCode.withheldAwaitingDevices`. A device holds back data gated on a capability until every attached device advertises it. This build gates the `glossaryEntry` and `figureNote` record kinds and the `show_custom_figures` and `compound_shorthands` settings on `glossary.v1`, and advertises it.
